description:
Please note that the patron type identified by pt-001 is titled **Student Member**. This category is defined for patrons who are currently enrolled students and therefore qualify for reduced access. The description reads: “Patrons who are enrolled students, eligible for reduced access.” The record follows the specification available at https://ils.rero.ch/schemas/patron_types/patron_type-v0.0.1.json and is linked to the organisation located at https://ils.rero.ch/api/organisations/12345.  

A yearly subscription fee of 25.0 CHF is associated with this patron type, reflecting the modest charge applied to student members.
